subject: website
name: WebTorrent
summary: WebTorrent Desktop, the streaming BitTorrent client, running whole inside Orivon. Its code is open source and it runs only what it ships. Every piece is checked against the hashes the torrent's info hash commits to, so no peer can pass off other content. Trackers and the DHT only say where peers are: any of many will do and a wrong answer costs time, never integrity, so the app relies on no server. Torrents, downloads and settings stay on this computer. That is Level 4. Not private: trackers, the DHT and every peer see your IP address and which torrents you fetch or share.

operations.name: Download and stream a torrent
operations.note: Each piece is checked against the torrent's own hashes before it is kept or played; peers see what you fetch.

operations.name: Share files (seed) and create torrents
operations.note: The torrent is made on this computer; peers that ask get its pieces and see your IP address.

operations.name: Keep torrents, downloads and settings
operations.note: Stored only in this app's own files on this computer.

connections.name: BitTorrent peers (TCP and WebRTC)
connections.note: What a peer sends is checked against the torrent's hashes. Each peer sees your IP address and what you fetch or share.

connections.name: Trackers and the DHT
connections.note: They only list peers, so a wrong answer costs time, never integrity. They see your IP address and the info hashes you ask about.
